FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 396
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/16/2026
House Bill 396 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
State Department of Education (SDE) to adopt rules to update the school grading system not
later than December 31, 2026.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Workforce
Board, in consultation with SDE, to develop a system to track student outcomes pursuant to the
provisions of the bill and to provide an annual report to the Legislature.
